name: cl-orchestration
description: Coordinates the issues of several projects from one session: worker jobs started through Orca, reviews and merge checks, and a handoff file that a cleared or compacted coordinator resumes from.

rotateAtTokens.title: Clear an idle coordinator above this many context tokens
rotateAtTokens.description: 200000 by default; 0 turns it off while rotateAtPercent is also 0. Applies only to a session whose project folder (where Claude Code started) holds the handoff file of /cl-orchestration:coordinate (.cedarloom/runs/handoff.md) and whose file names that session's id (a Session: line). When such a coordinator ends a turn with no background task running and its context is above this size, the plugin clears it with /clear and submits a prompt that resumes it from the file; after a clear or compaction it hands the file back. At most one clear every 10 minutes. Without the file nothing happens.

rotateAtPercent.title: Clear an idle coordinator above this percent of the context window
rotateAtPercent.description: 0 (default) is off and rotateAtTokens applies. Above 0, an idle coordinator that keeps the handoff file of /cl-orchestration:coordinate is cleared with /clear and resumed from the file once its context fills this percent of the model's context window, in place of rotateAtTokens.
